title: Smoked Chicken Pilaf
description: A French-inspired dish featuring smoked chicken, potatoes, and pilaf, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the smoked chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the smoked paprika and Jamaican jerk seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cubed potatoes to the skillet and cook until they begin to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the potatoes and spices.
Return the smoked chicken breast to the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
